description.label: Description
description.value:
Awarded For: Slaying a powerful and dangerous Daemon, Greenskin or Undead champion such as a Daemon Lord of Chaos, Greenskin Warboss, Master Necromancer or Vampire Lord in melee combat.

Description: An iron medallion with the image of the Twin Tailed Comet etched on top and a red gemstone inserted in its center.

Bonuses: The medal wearer’s melee attacks against Daemons, Greenskins and Undead gain the Damaging Weapon Quality. Any warhammers (the signature weapon of Sigmar) or swords you wield gain +1 Damage with this medal equipped. If you do not have either the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.zGQ0ShUTSlUvVtWh]{Warrior Born} or @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.Zf0vk2rjllpDh0Ua]{Very Strong} Talent already, one may be added to the Talent list of any career you are in.

Automation (Wave 3): Until automated, the GM applies the bonuses above manually when the medal is worn (Imperial Honors) or when the honor applies (Kill Counts).

Medal Notes

Talents granted by medals apply only to the original recipient. Non-talent bonuses require the medal to be worn by the earner. Non-earners do not gain these benefits — the GM enforces recipient rules (no automatic earner lock). Medals can be identified with Easy (+40) Lore (Empire / Heraldry / History). Fake medals: Evaluate + Numismatics (GM difficulty).
